activity.notes: Hülegü (Hulegu/Hulagu) founded the Il-khanid dynasty during the Mongol conquest of Iran and ruled until his death on 8 February 1265. ATLAS reuses the existing Ilkhanate polity and records the standard 1256–1265 sovereign interval.

sources.title: HULĀGU KHAN — Encyclopaedia Iranica
sources.citation_text: Encyclopaedia Iranica identifies Hülegü as founder of the Il-khanid dynasty, describes his 1256 campaign against the Ismaʿilis and records his death on 8 February 1265.

sources.title: Hulegu Khan — biographical reference
sources.citation_text: The biographical chronology gives Hulegu's reign as 1256 to 8 February 1265 and identifies him as founder of the Ilkhanate in Persia.
